findings.current:
“Here! It’s delicious! Try some!”

“…You eat plenty.”

“I’m eating!”
findings.defect: Cheongpung's words are clearly distorted because his mouth is full, but the draft renders them as ordinary speech. The final line also changes his response from the mouth-full equivalent of “Thanks, I will” to the ongoing action “I’m eating.”
findings.rationale: The phonetic distortions are the physical mechanism of the joke, and 먹겠습니다 expresses an eager acceptance rather than a statement that he is already eating.
findings.replacement:
“Hewe! It’s delishush! Try shome!”

“…You eat plenty.”

“Thanksh, I will!”
findings.source:
“으이! 마이어으! 드스 브스으!”

“……너나 많이 드세요.”

“즈 므그스느드!”

findings.current: I may not be a martial artist, but I’ve seen and heard enough in my time, so you should look forward to it.
findings.defect: “Look forward to it” implies positive anticipation. Jang Taebo is instead invoking his worldly experience to tell Taekyung to trust his prediction that a large, disorderly crowd will appear.
findings.rationale: 기대해 보게 functions here as confidence in Jang Taebo's forecast, not an invitation to anticipate the event with pleasure.
findings.replacement: I may not be a martial artist, but I have enough worldly experience to know. Just wait and see.
findings.source: 내 비록 무림인은 아니지만 보고 들은 경륜은 제법 되니 기대해 보게.

findings.current: “Ten thousand silver nyang? We’ll have to pull up every last pillar of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”
findings.defect: The inclusive “we” makes Jang Taebo share responsibility for paying his own fee. He is telling Taekyung that such a payment would strip the Jin Family of Taiyuan bare.
findings.rationale: The implied subject is Taekyung and his family, whose money Taekyung has just offered to spend; Jang Taebo is the proposed recipient.
findings.replacement: “Ten thousand silver nyang? You’d have to pull up every last pillar of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.”
findings.source: “은자 만 냥을? 태원 진가 기둥뿌리를 죄다 뽑아야겠구먼.”

findings.current: That man could probably write an autobiography. He could call it *A Hundred Ways to Get Yourself Beaten to Death*.
findings.defect: “That man” sanitizes the strongly contemptuous 저 새끼 and weakens Taekyung's profane narrative voice.
findings.rationale: 새끼 is a direct insult here, prompted by Hyuk Mujin's shameless request, and should not be neutralized.
findings.replacement: That bastard could probably write an autobiography. He could call it *A Hundred Ways to Get Yourself Beaten to Death*.
findings.source: 저 새끼는 자서전 써도 될 것 같다. 제목은 [맞아 뒤지는 방법 100선].

findings.defect: “Damn it” softens the explicitly strong profanity 시발 to the same level as the chapter's separate uses of 젠장.
findings.rationale: The source deliberately escalates to stronger profanity when Taekyung realizes Jeok Cheongang is heating the space beneath the table with the Flame Divine Palm.

findings.defect: The neutral verb “ate” removes the contemptuous vulgarity of 처먹었지 and flattens Jeok Cheongang's insulting delivery.
findings.rationale: 처먹다 is a deliberately coarse form of “eat”; the replacement preserves that register while remaining natural for a pill.

findings.defect: The plural pronoun treats all the possessions as learnable, even though Taekyung is referring to learning the martial art recorded in the manual.
findings.rationale: 익히다 in this context means mastering or practicing the Flame Divine Palm, not learning the physical items collectively.
findings.replacement: “What if I learn the martial art?”

findings.defect: The draft again softens 시발 and produces an unnatural English reaction.
findings.rationale: The source is Taekyung's profane disbelief at being forced to retain property he is trying to return.

findings.defect: The draft changes the subject from Jeok Cheongang to a collective “we” and represents mouth-obstructed speech as nervous stuttering.
findings.rationale: 가시게요 asks whether the addressed elder is leaving, while the distorted syllables show that Cheongpung is speaking with his mouth full.

findings.current: After exchanging a nod with Jang Taebo, Jeok Cheongang turned away and tossed out one meaningful remark.
findings.defect: The draft changes an exchanged greeting made with the eyes into a nod, introducing a different physical action.
findings.rationale: 눈인사 specifically denotes acknowledging or greeting someone with the eyes; the source does not describe either man nodding.
findings.replacement: After exchanging a silent glance of farewell with Jang Taebo, Jeok Cheongang turned away and tossed out one meaningful remark.
findings.source: 장태보와도 눈인사를 주고받은 그는 의미심장한 한마디를 던지고 돌아섰다.

summary: The draft contains two consequential subject changes, several losses of mouth-full speech and profanity, and localized action and pragmatic inaccuracies.
